title: "The Horse Race"
format:
  html:
    css: horse-race.css
    toc: false
    page-layout: full
---

```{=html}
<header class="race-header">
  <p class="header-eyebrow">Probability &amp; Statistics</p>
  <h1>The Horse Race</h1>
  <p>
    Roll two fair dice. The horse whose number matches the sum moves one step forward.
    A race has <strong>100 rolls</strong>. The right-hand columns show the cumulative count and frequency
    of each sum across <strong>all rolls since Reset</strong>.
  </p>
</header>

<main class="card">
  <section class="stats">
    <div class="stat">
      <div class="stat-label">Race #</div>
      <div class="stat-val" id="stat-race">0</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat">
      <div class="stat-label">Current race roll</div>
      <div class="stat-val" id="stat-roll">0</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat">
      <div class="stat-label">Total rolls</div>
      <div class="stat-val" id="stat-total-rolls">0</div>
    </div>
    <div class="stat">
      <div class="stat-label">Last winner</div>
      <div class="stat-val amber" id="stat-winner">—</div>
    </div>
  </section>

  <div class="winner-banner" id="winner-banner">
    🏆 <span id="winner-text">Horse 7 wins the race!</span>
  </div>

  <div class="roll-info" id="roll-info">
    <span>Press <strong>Roll once</strong> or <strong>Run race</strong> to begin.</span>
  </div>

  <div class="track-head">
    <span></span>
    <span></span>
    <span class="track-head-stat">Count</span>
    <span class="track-head-stat">Freq.</span>
  </div>

  <section class="track" id="track"></section>

  <section class="controls">
    <button class="primary" id="btn-roll">Roll once</button>
    <button id="btn-race">Run race (100 rolls)</button>
    <button id="btn-many">Run 20 races</button>
    <button class="danger" id="btn-reset">Reset</button>
  </section>

  <section class="speed-row">
    <span>Speed:</span>
    <input type="range" id="speed" min="1" max="5" value="3" step="1">
    <span id="speed-label">medium</span>
  </section>

  <section class="prob-section">
    <p class="prob-title">Theoretical probability of each dice sum</p>
    <div class="prob-chips" id="prob-chips"></div>
  </section>

  <section class="history-section" id="history-section">
    <p class="history-title">Race winners</p>
    <div class="wins-chips" id="wins-chips"></div>
  </section>
</main>

<footer class="race-footer">
  Built for classroom use · Two fair dice · 100 rolls per race
</footer>

<script>
const HORSES = Array.from({length: 11}, (_, i) => i + 2);
const ROLLS_PER_RACE = 100;

const BAR_COLORS = {
  2:'#c0392b', 3:'#e67e22', 4:'#27ae60', 5:'#2980b9', 6:'#8e44ad',
  7:'#3ddc97', 8:'#8e44ad', 9:'#2980b9', 10:'#27ae60', 11:'#e67e22', 12:'#c0392b'
};
const WINNER_COLOR = '#f0a500';
const DICE_ICONS = ['⚀','⚁','⚂','⚃','⚄','⚅'];
const SPEED_LABELS = ['very slow','slow','medium','fast','very fast'];
const SPEED_DELAYS = [650, 270, 110, 35, 6];

let raceSteps = {};
let totalCounts = {};
let raceWins = {};
let currentRaceRolls = 0;
let totalRolls = 0;
let totalRaces = 0;
let animRunning = false;
let animTimer = null;

function waysForSum(n) {
  let ways = 0;
  for (let a = 1; a <= 6; a++) {
    for (let b = 1; b <= 6; b++) {
      if (a + b === n) ways++;
    }
  }
  return ways;
}

function trueProb(n) {
  return waysForSum(n) / 36;
}

function rollDie() {
  return Math.floor(Math.random() * 6) + 1;
}

function getDelay() {
  return SPEED_DELAYS[Number(document.getElementById('speed').value) - 1];
}

function init() {
  clearTimeout(animTimer);
  animRunning = false;
  currentRaceRolls = 0;
  totalRolls = 0;
  totalRaces = 0;

  HORSES.forEach(h => {
    raceSteps[h] = 0;
    totalCounts[h] = 0;
    raceWins[h] = 0;
  });

  buildTrack();
  buildProbChips();
  updateTrack();
  updateCumulativeStats();

  document.getElementById('stat-race').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('stat-roll').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('stat-total-rolls').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('stat-winner').textContent = '—';
  document.getElementById('roll-info').innerHTML = 'Press <strong>Roll once</strong> or <strong>Run race</strong> to begin.';
  document.getElementById('winner-banner').classList.remove('show');
  document.getElementById('history-section').style.display = 'none';
  document.getElementById('wins-chips').innerHTML = '';
  setButtons(false);
}

function resetCurrentRaceOnly() {
  HORSES.forEach(h => { raceSteps[h] = 0; });
  currentRaceRolls = 0;
  document.getElementById('stat-roll').textContent = '0';
  document.getElementById('winner-banner').classList.remove('show');
  updateTrack();
}

function buildTrack() {
  const el = document.getElementById('track');
  el.innerHTML = '';

  HORSES.forEach(h => {
    const lane = document.createElement('div');
    lane.className = 'lane';
    lane.innerHTML = `
      <span class="lane-num${h === 7 ? ' seven' : ''}">${h}</span>
      <div class="bar-wrap">
        <div class="bar" id="bar-${h}" style="width:0%;background:${BAR_COLORS[h]}"></div>
      </div>
      <span class="lane-count${h === 7 ? ' seven' : ''}" id="count-${h}">0</span>
      <span class="lane-freq${h === 7 ? ' seven' : ''}" id="freq-${h}">0.000</span>
    `;
    el.appendChild(lane);
  });
}

function updateTrack() {
  HORSES.forEach(h => {
    const bar = document.getElementById('bar-' + h);
    const pct = Math.min(100 * raceSteps[h] / ROLLS_PER_RACE, 100);
    bar.style.width = pct + '%';
    bar.style.background = BAR_COLORS[h];
    bar.innerHTML = pct > 7 ? `<span class="bar-label">${raceSteps[h]}</span>` : '';
  });
}

function updateCumulativeStats() {
  HORSES.forEach(h => {
    const countEl = document.getElementById('count-' + h);
    const freqEl = document.getElementById('freq-' + h);
    const count = totalCounts[h] || 0;
    const freq = totalRolls === 0 ? 0 : count / totalRolls;
    countEl.textContent = count;
    freqEl.textContent = freq.toFixed(3);
  });
}

function buildProbChips() {
  const el = document.getElementById('prob-chips');
  el.innerHTML = '';

  HORSES.forEach(h => {
    const chip = document.createElement('span');
    chip.className = 'prob-chip' + (h === 7 ? ' seven' : '');
    const ways = waysForSum(h);
    chip.textContent = `${h}: ${ways}/36 = ${trueProb(h).toFixed(3)}`;
    el.appendChild(chip);
  });
}

function doRoll() {
  const d1 = rollDie();
  const d2 = rollDie();
  const sum = d1 + d2;

  raceSteps[sum]++;
  totalCounts[sum]++;
  currentRaceRolls++;
  totalRolls++;

  document.getElementById('stat-roll').textContent = currentRaceRolls;
  document.getElementById('stat-total-rolls').textContent = totalRolls;
  document.getElementById('roll-info').innerHTML =
    `<span class="dice">${DICE_ICONS[d1-1]} ${DICE_ICONS[d2-1]}</span>
     <span>= ${sum}</span>
     <span class="sum-badge">Horse ${sum} moves!</span>`;

  updateTrack();
  updateCumulativeStats();
}

function getRaceWinner() {
  const maxSteps = Math.max(...HORSES.map(h => raceSteps[h]));
  const winners = HORSES.filter(h => raceSteps[h] === maxSteps);
  return winners[Math.floor(Math.random() * winners.length)];
}

function recordWin(winner) {
  totalRaces++;
  raceWins[winner] = (raceWins[winner] || 0) + 1;

  document.getElementById('stat-race').textContent = totalRaces;
  document.getElementById('stat-winner').textContent = `🐴 ${winner}`;
  document.getElementById('winner-banner').classList.add('show');
  document.getElementById('winner-text').textContent =
    `Horse ${winner} wins race #${totalRaces} after ${ROLLS_PER_RACE} rolls!`;

  const chip = document.createElement('span');
  chip.className = 'win-chip' + (winner === 7 ? ' seven' : '');
  chip.textContent = `🐴${winner}`;
  document.getElementById('wins-chips').appendChild(chip);
  document.getElementById('history-section').style.display = '';
}

function setButtons(running) {
  document.getElementById('btn-roll').disabled = running;
  document.getElementById('btn-race').disabled = running;
  document.getElementById('btn-many').disabled = running;
}

function finishRace(onDone) {
  const winner = getRaceWinner();
  recordWin(winner);
  animRunning = false;
  setButtons(false);
  if (onDone) onDone();
}

function runOneRace(onDone, autoResetBeforeStart = true) {
  if (autoResetBeforeStart && currentRaceRolls > 0) {
    resetCurrentRaceOnly();
  }

  animRunning = true;
  setButtons(true);

  function step() {
    if (currentRaceRolls >= ROLLS_PER_RACE) {
      finishRace(onDone);
      return;
    }
    doRoll();
    animTimer = setTimeout(step, getDelay());
  }

  step();
}

function runManyRaces(n) {
  if (n <= 0) {
    animRunning = false;
    setButtons(false);
    return;
  }

  if (currentRaceRolls > 0) {
    resetCurrentRaceOnly();
  }

  animRunning = true;
  setButtons(true);

  function runNext(remaining) {
    if (remaining <= 0) {
      animRunning = false;
      setButtons(false);
      return;
    }

    resetCurrentRaceOnly();

    function step() {
      if (currentRaceRolls >= ROLLS_PER_RACE) {
        const winner = getRaceWinner();
        recordWin(winner);
        setTimeout(() => runNext(remaining - 1), Math.max(getDelay() * 3, 80));
        return;
      }
      doRoll();
      animTimer = setTimeout(step, getDelay());
    }

    step();
  }

  runNext(n);
}

document.getElementById('btn-roll').addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (animRunning) return;

  document.getElementById('winner-banner').classList.remove('show');

  if (currentRaceRolls >= ROLLS_PER_RACE) {
    resetCurrentRaceOnly();
  }

  doRoll();

  if (currentRaceRolls >= ROLLS_PER_RACE) {
    finishRace(null);
  }
});

document.getElementById('btn-race').addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (animRunning) return;
  document.getElementById('winner-banner').classList.remove('show');
  runOneRace(null, true);
});

document.getElementById('btn-many').addEventListener('click', () => {
  if (animRunning) return;
  document.getElementById('winner-banner').classList.remove('show');
  runManyRaces(20);
});

document.getElementById('btn-reset').addEventListener('click', () => {
  init();
});

document.getElementById('speed').addEventListener('input', function() {
  document.getElementById('speed-label').textContent = SPEED_LABELS[Number(this.value) - 1];
});

init();
</script>
```
